# IT & Digital Deployment Plan

This plan details key deployment and security-related tasks for the IT & Digital department, with a focus on initiatives for Strategy 2026.

## Key Tasks:

*   Monitor the database migration for Strategy 2026.
*   Review the database migration urgently.
*   Investigate the encryption standards urgently.
*   Update the encryption standards quarterly.
*   Optimize the firewall settings for Strategy 2026.
